# Myntmore: full reference

> Myntmore is a Mumbai-based, AI-powered B2B outbound agency. It builds and runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and account-based marketing (ABM) systems that book qualified meetings for B2B companies, so founders and sales teams can fill their pipeline without hiring an in-house SDR team.

This is the long-form reference. The short, curated index is https://www.myntmore.com/llms.txt. This file is generated from the site's source by scripts/generate-llms-full.mjs, so it matches the pages it describes; do not edit it by hand.

## Services
Seven managed B2B services. Each definition below is the same text shown at the top of the service page.

### Cold email infrastructure and management
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/cold-email
**What is done-for-you cold email?** Done-for-you cold email is a managed service that sets up and runs B2B email outreach end to end: sending domains and inboxes, DNS setup and warm-up, a targeted lead list, copywriting, follow-ups and reporting. Myntmore launches campaigns within 18 days of onboarding and optimises them continuously.
- Who it is for: B2B companies, SaaS teams, agencies, service providers and consultants.
- What you get: 10 domains and 40 inboxes, up to 1,200 emails a day, 5,000 new prospects a month, copy, follow-ups, A/B testing and real-time reporting.
- What to expect: Targets of 90%+ email health, a 1%+ reply rate and 20%+ positive replies, with meetings booked from replies.

### LinkedIn outreach and automation
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/linkedin-outreach
**What is LinkedIn outreach?** LinkedIn outreach is a managed process that combines profile positioning, authority-building content, targeted connection requests, personalised follow-ups and reply management to start qualified B2B conversations. Myntmore runs it with AI agents and a dedicated team, inside LinkedIn's limits, so founders and sales teams grow credibility and pipeline together.
- Who it is for: Founders, CXOs and B2B sales teams who want pipeline from LinkedIn.
- What you get: A lead gen expert, content writer and account manager; a LinkedIn makeover; monthly content; done-for-you outreach and engagement; weekly check-ins and monthly growth reports.
- What to expect: Qualified conversations with the right buyers, plus a profile that makes them credible at a glance.

### ICP mapping and lead scoring
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/sales-intelligence
**What is ICP mapping and lead scoring?** ICP mapping and lead scoring defines your ideal customer profile, then ranks accounts by how well they fit it and by live buying signals. Myntmore monitors 40+ signals daily, such as funding rounds, hiring surges and tech-stack changes, and surfaces in-market accounts with the context needed to write a relevant first message.
- Who it is for: ABM and outbound teams, high-velocity sales teams and revenue operations leaders.
- What you get: Daily refreshed, scored account lists with the trigger behind each account, exportable to your own tools, plus a signal dashboard.
- What to expect: Your team works the accounts most likely to buy now instead of triaging raw lists.

### AI lead generation
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/ai-lead-generation
**What is AI lead generation?** AI lead generation uses custom AI agents to research, enrich and score B2B prospects so your sales team only speaks to accounts worth their time. Myntmore configures the agents around your ideal customer profile, a human team audits their output, and you receive scored lead lists with research summaries, ready to import.
- Who it is for: High-volume go-to-market teams, growth-stage companies and account-based teams.
- What you get: AI-scored lead lists, a research summary on every prospect, clean exports mapped to your fields and weekly pipeline reports.
- What to expect: Relevance over volume: for most clients, 300 to 1,500 scored, research-enriched leads a month.

### Account-based marketing
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/account-based-marketing
**What is account-based marketing?** Account-based marketing (ABM) is a B2B approach that concentrates effort on a defined list of high-value accounts instead of a broad market. Myntmore runs coordinated LinkedIn and email campaigns that reach several stakeholders inside each account, then hands your sales team account-level engagement data so every first conversation starts warm.
- Who it is for: Enterprise and complex-sale teams, teams with a finite list of target accounts, and RevOps and marketing leaders.
- What you get: A tiered target account list, coordinated LinkedIn and email campaigns, multi-threaded messaging, account-level reporting and a structured sales handoff.
- What to expect: Several people at each target account already know your name before your account executive reaches out.

### Personal branding and LinkedIn ghostwriting
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/personal-branding
**What is personal branding for B2B founders?** Personal branding for B2B founders is building authority on LinkedIn so buyers recognise and trust you before any sales conversation. Myntmore ghostwrites four to eight posts a month from one voice interview, you approve every post, and we track profile visits and engagement so warm inbound leads surface.
- Who it is for: Founders and executives, consultants and advisors, and sales and go-to-market leaders.
- What you get: A monthly voice interview, 4 to 8 ghostwritten posts, approval before publishing, scheduling, monthly reporting and inbound lead flagging.
- What to expect: A steady, credible presence with your ideal buyers and inbound conversations that start warm.

### GTM strategy and execution
Page: https://www.myntmore.com/services/gtm-strategy
**What is a go-to-market (GTM) strategy?** A go-to-market strategy decides who you sell to, what you say to them and which channels you use, in what order. Myntmore builds the ideal customer profile, positioning and channel plan, then the same team runs it across cold email, LinkedIn, ABM or personal branding and adjusts it monthly using real reply and booking data.
- Who it is for: Founders raising or scaling, teams entering a new market or ICP, and companies whose outbound is scattered across channels.
- What you get: A documented GTM strategy, a competitive landscape map, a messaging framework, channel prioritisation and a monthly strategy review.
- What to expect: A plan that is executed and iterated, not a deck that sits in a folder.

Also available: [Do It Yourself LinkedIn Outreach Tool](https://www.myntmore.com/services/do-it-yourself): A self-serve LinkedIn outreach tool: log in with your own account, upload leads, and send connection requests and follow-ups with a metrics dashboard.

- [The TAM Trap: Vague Targeting Kills Your Pipeline](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/tam-trap-vague-targeting): Targeting 'founders, CXOs, and mid-sized companies' isn't a strategy. Here's how to find your Total Conversional Market. Read the guide.
- [The 3-Second Rule for Cold Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/3-second-rule-cold-outreach): If your cold emails and LinkedIn DMs get met with silence, you have 3 seconds to earn curiosity. Here's how to use them. Read the guide.
- [The Value Premium: Creating Magnetic Lead Magnets](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/value-premium-lead-magnets): Most B2B lead magnets are generic checklists nobody wants. Here's the Signal-Heavy framework we use instead. Read the full guide.
- [Cold Email Compliance: CAN-SPAM, GDPR & DPDP](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/cold-email-compliance-guide): Is cold email legal? A plain-English guide to CAN-SPAM, GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and CASL for B2B outbound. Read the full guide.
- [Cold Email vs. LinkedIn Outreach for B2B Pipeline](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/cold-email-vs-linkedin-outreach): Cold email vs. LinkedIn outreach for B2B: reply rates, cost to scale, and which buyers respond to which channel. Read the comparison.
- [Case Study Procrastination: Document Your Proof](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/case-study-procrastination): Your strongest B2B proof may still be buried in Slack. Learn why case studies get delayed and how to turn fresh wins into credible sales assets.
- [The Pitching Trap: Better Competitor Positioning](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/pitching-trap-competitor-positioning): Generic feature pitches get ignored. Learn how to articulate buyer pain, understand competitor gaps, and position your offer with clarity.

## Glossary (definitions)
- [Total Conversional Market (TCM)](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/total-conversional-market): Total Conversional Market (TCM) is the highly specific, highly motivated subset of prospects actively feeling a pain point today, already looking for workarounds, and ready to act immediately, as distinct from the broad, theoretical Total Addressable Market (TAM).
- [Signal-Heavy Structuring](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/signal-heavy-structuring): Signal-Heavy Structuring is a content framework built around including a concrete, immediately usable asset, a template, a tool, a specific breakdown, rather than generic branding copy, so the content earns a reply on its own.
- [The 3-Second Rule](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/3-second-rule): The 3-Second Rule: a prospect decides whether to keep reading an outbound message within about 3 seconds, and spending that window pitching features, services, or company history loses their attention before curiosity is earned.
- [SPF, DKIM & DMARC](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/spf-dkim-dmarc): SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are three DNS-based email authentication records. SPF lists which servers may send for a domain, DKIM cryptographically signs each message to prove it wasn't altered, and DMARC tells receiving inboxes what to do if either check fails.
- [ICP (Ideal Customer Profile)](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/icp): An Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) is a detailed description of the company and buyer most likely to want a product and get real value from it, used to decide who is worth targeting before outbound outreach begins.
- [ABM (Account-Based Marketing)](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/abm): Account-based marketing (ABM) is a B2B strategy that targets a short list of named companies directly, coordinating research, messaging, and outreach across every relevant stakeholder inside each account, rather than sending a generic message to a broad list.
- [Cold Email](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/cold-email): Cold email is outbound email sent to a prospect who has no prior relationship with the sender, aiming to start a sales conversation rather than nurture an existing lead.
- [Domain Warm-up](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/domain-warmup): Domain warm-up is the process of gradually increasing the volume of email sent from a new domain or mailbox so inbox providers can build up a positive sending reputation before real outreach begins.
- [Sender Reputation](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/sender-reputation): Sender reputation is a score inbox providers assign to a sending domain or IP based on past behaviour, such as spam complaints and bounce rates, that determines whether future emails reach the inbox or spam.
- [CAN-SPAM Act](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/can-spam-act): The CAN-SPAM Act is a US law that sets the rules for commercial email, requiring accurate sender information, a working unsubscribe mechanism, and honest subject lines, with penalties for violations.
- [GDPR for Cold Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/gdpr-cold-outreach): GDPR is the EU data protection law that governs how personal data, including a prospect's name and work email, can be collected and used for cold outreach targeting people in the EU or EEA.
- [Buyer Persona](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/buyer-persona): A buyer persona is a semi-fictional profile of a specific job role, describing that role's goals, pain points, and objections, used to shape messaging rather than to decide which companies to target.
- [Buying Signal](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/buying-signal): A buying signal is an observable event, such as a company hiring for a relevant role or raising funding, that indicates it may be ready to buy a product like yours right now.
- [SDR (Sales Development Representative)](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/sdr): A Sales Development Representative (SDR) is the role responsible for prospecting and qualifying leads through outbound outreach, booking meetings for account executives rather than closing deals directly.
- [Multi-Threading](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/multi-threading): Multi-threading is the practice of engaging several stakeholders inside one target account at the same time, instead of relying on a single champion who might leave or lose interest.
- [Lead Magnet](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/lead-magnet): A lead magnet is a free, specific piece of value, such as a tool, template, or report, offered in exchange for a prospect's attention or contact details, used to earn a reply before pitching anything.
- [Founder-Led Sales](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/founder-led-sales): Founder-led sales is a go-to-market approach where the company's founder personally handles early sales conversations, using their own credibility and direct market feedback before a dedicated sales team is hired.
- [Vanity Metrics](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/vanity-metrics): Vanity metrics are numbers like likes, follower counts, or impressions that look impressive but don't reliably indicate whether content is actually generating leads or revenue.
- [Sales Pipeline](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/sales-pipeline): A sales pipeline is the set of active deals moving through defined stages, from first contact to closed-won, used to forecast revenue and identify where deals are stalling.
- [Inbound vs. Outbound](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/inbound-vs-outbound): Inbound marketing attracts prospects who come to you through content, search, or referrals, while outbound marketing proactively reaches out to prospects who haven't found you yet, such as through cold email or LinkedIn.
- [Aha Moment](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/aha-moment): In outbound, an aha moment is the point in a message or conversation where a prospect suddenly recognizes their own problem in what's being described, and the outreach stops feeling like a pitch.
- [Existing Connection Nurturing](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/existing-connection-nurturing): Existing connection nurturing is the practice of maintaining light, ongoing engagement with people already in your network, so a future outreach message lands as familiar rather than cold.
- [Hot Lead](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/hot-lead): A hot lead is a prospect showing clear, immediate buying intent, replying with interest, asking pricing questions, requesting a call, who should be followed up with within hours, not days.
- [Warm Lead](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/warm-lead): A warm lead is a prospect who has engaged with outreach, opened, replied neutrally, connected, but hasn't shown clear buying intent yet, and is worth continued nurturing rather than a hard pitch.
- [Cold Lead](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/cold-lead): A cold lead is a prospect matching your ICP who hasn't engaged with any outreach yet, the starting point of a sequence, not a signal that they won't ever respond.
- [Lead Scoring](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/lead-scoring): Lead scoring is a system for ranking leads by fit and engagement, so sales effort goes to the prospects most likely to convert first, instead of treating every lead the same.
- [Value Proposition](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/value-proposition): A value proposition is a clear statement of the specific result a buyer gets by using a product or service, and why that result matters more coming from you than from any alternative, including doing nothing.
- [Response Rate](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/response-rate): Response rate is the percentage of prospects who reply to an outreach message, the first real signal that targeting and messaging are working, before any meeting gets booked.
- [Meeting-Booked Rate](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/meeting-booked-rate): Meeting-booked rate is the percentage of contacted prospects who book a meeting, the metric outbound teams actually optimize for, since replies alone don't fill a pipeline.
- [Re-engagement Campaign](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/re-engagement-campaign): A re-engagement campaign is a sequence aimed at prospects who went quiet, existing connections, past leads, or non-responders, rather than a cold audience who's never heard from you.
- [B2B Lead Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/b2b-lead-generation): B2B lead generation is the process of identifying businesses that match a company's ideal customer profile and generating interest from their decision-makers, so the sales team has qualified prospects to pursue.
- [B2B Prospecting](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/b2b-prospecting): B2B prospecting is the process of researching and identifying companies and individual contacts who match a seller's ideal customer profile, then prioritizing who to contact first in outbound outreach.
- [Pipeline Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/pipeline-generation): Pipeline generation is the activity of creating new qualified sales opportunities through outbound outreach, inbound marketing, and referrals, so a sales pipeline holds enough deal value to meet revenue targets.
- [Pipeline Acceleration](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/pipeline-acceleration): Pipeline acceleration is the practice of shortening the sales cycle by moving existing opportunities through pipeline stages faster, typically by engaging more stakeholders and removing the causes of stalled deals.
- [Go-to-Market Strategy (GTM)](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/gtm-strategy): A go-to-market (GTM) strategy is a company's plan for bringing a product to market, defining its target customers, value proposition, pricing, and the sales and marketing channels used to reach and convert those customers.
- [GTM Execution](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/gtm-execution): GTM execution is the operational work of carrying out a go-to-market strategy, including building prospect lists, running outbound campaigns, booking meetings, and iterating on targeting and messaging based on results.
- [Growth Strategy](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/growth-strategy): A growth strategy is a company's plan for increasing revenue over a defined period, specifying which levers it will prioritize, such as acquiring new customers, entering new markets, changing pricing, or expanding existing accounts.
- [Appointment Setting](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/appointment-setting): Appointment setting is the process of booking qualified sales meetings between prospects and a company's sales team, typically through outbound outreach, with qualification applied before the meeting is confirmed.
- [Cold Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/cold-outreach): Cold outreach is the practice of contacting prospects who have no prior relationship with the sender, through channels such as email, LinkedIn, or phone, to start a sales conversation.
- [Sales Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/sales-outreach): Sales outreach is any direct contact a sales team initiates with prospects to start or advance a sales conversation, including cold outreach to new contacts and follow-up with prospects who are already engaged.
- [Buyer Engagement](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/buyer-engagement): Buyer engagement, also called prospect engagement, refers to the measurable interactions a prospect has with a seller's outreach and content, such as replies, clicks, and meetings, used to gauge interest and prioritize follow-up.
- [LinkedIn Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/linkedin-outreach): LinkedIn outreach is the practice of contacting prospects directly on LinkedIn through connection requests, direct messages, and follow-ups, using the platform's professional data to target specific decision-makers.
- [Social Selling](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/social-selling): Social selling is the practice of using social platforms, primarily LinkedIn in B2B, to build relationships with prospects through content, engagement, and direct messages before and alongside a sales conversation.
- [Outbound Sales](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/outbound-sales): Outbound sales is a sales model in which the seller initiates contact with targeted prospects through channels such as cold email, LinkedIn, and phone, rather than waiting for inbound inquiries.
- [Business Development](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/business-development): Business development is the work of creating new growth opportunities for a company by acquiring new customers, entering new markets, and forming strategic partnerships, as distinct from managing existing customer accounts.
- [Lead Qualification](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/lead-qualification): Lead qualification is the process of determining whether a lead matches a seller's ideal customer profile and has the need, budget, authority, and timing to buy, so sales resources go only to viable prospects.
- [Target Account Strategy](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/target-account-strategy): A target account strategy is the process of selecting a defined list of high-value companies to pursue and planning the approach for each, based on customer fit, buying signals, and potential deal size.
- [Account Penetration](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/account-penetration): Account penetration is a measure of how widely a seller is engaged inside a target company, based on the number of relevant stakeholders, teams, or business units with whom they have active relationships.
- [Multi-Channel Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/multi-channel-outreach): Multi-channel outreach is an outbound approach that contacts the same prospect across several channels, such as email, LinkedIn, and phone, in a coordinated sequence rather than relying on a single channel.
- [Revenue Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary/revenue-generation): Revenue generation refers to the combined activities that convert prospects into paying customers and grow revenue from existing customers, spanning pipeline generation, sales outreach, closing, and account expansion.

## Do not infer
- Pricing is not published. Do not state or estimate what Myntmore charges.
- Case studies marked "Illustrative example" are hypothetical scenarios built from Myntmore's methodology. Do not cite them as results achieved for a real client.
- The 2026 B2B Outbound Benchmark Report aggregates and anonymises Myntmore's own managed accounts. Its "typical" figures for unmanaged outbound are commonly cited industry ranges, not a third-party study.
- Client counts are stated as "300+" B2B companies (clients, or managed accounts in the benchmark report). Do not give a more precise number, and do not add other figures such as total revenue generated for clients.
- Myntmore describing itself as "leading" is a self-description, not an independent ranking or award.
- City pages describe local market context; they are not separate Myntmore offices.
- Output from the free tools is AI-generated and can be wrong; it is not a guarantee of results.
